shapes.label: IdeaMesh
shapes.desc: Top bar with the app name on the left and a link to the ideas repo on the right. No other navigation, because this one screen is the whole tool.

shapes.label: Describe today's idea…
shapes.desc: The single prompt that starts everything. Free text, so the user can type the idea the way they would say it. This should very much so also either have a zoom in window that would work like ideaCooker so that you can make these features that are in here before doing anything else.

shapes.label: Run mesh
shapes.desc: Sends the prompt through every active brick in order. It is disabled while the input is empty or a run is in progress, and shows a spinner during a run.

shapes.label: Brick network
shapes.desc:
A canvas that shows how the bricks connect, drawn as a flow from left to right. While a run is in progress, the active brick is highlighted and the arrows fill in as each step finishes.
A feature is that you can zoom in and out of this

shapes.label: Prompt
shapes.desc: Start node that represents the prompt from field 2. Clicking it scrolls up to the input.
Arrow from the prompt to the first brick.

shapes.label: Ideas repo
shapes.desc: Brick that writes the dated idea folder and README, then pushes it to the repo. Clicking it opens its settings in the inspector (15). It shows the last commit time.
Arrow that passes the new idea folder on to the portfolio brick.

shapes.label: Portfolio + text
shapes.desc: Brick that adds the idea to the portfolio and generates its portfolio text from the README. Clicking it selects it in the inspector.
Arrow from the portfolio brick to the website brick. It is drawn dashed while the next brick is only planned.

shapes.label: Public website · planned
shapes.desc: Future brick that pushes the idea to a folder on a public website. It is shown greyed out and skipped during runs until it is switched on.

shapes.label: PassRotor
shapes.desc: An earlier idea plugged in as a brick, shown to make it clear that ideas can become bricks. Its exact role is still open, for example supplying credentials to the bricks that push.
Connection from PassRotor down to the Ideas repo brick, showing that one brick can feed another without being in the main row.

shapes.label: Add brick
shapes.desc: Opens a picker of available bricks, including other ideas from the repo. The user drops the chosen brick onto the canvas and draws its connections.

shapes.label: Inspector
shapes.desc: Shows details for the selected brick so the user can update or upgrade it without changing the rest of the network.

shapes.label: Portfolio + text · v2
shapes.desc: Name and version of the selected brick, with an on/off switch next to it so the brick can be skipped during runs.

shapes.label: Takes · Gives · Settings
shapes.desc: What the brick takes in (for example the idea folder), what it produces (for example the portfolio entry) and its editable settings, such as the tone of the generated text.

shapes.label: Upgrade to v3
shapes.desc: Swaps in a newer version of the selected brick and keeps its connections. It is only shown when an upgrade exists.

shapes.label: Run log
shapes.desc: Latest runs, newest first. Each row shows the idea name, which bricks succeeded or failed, and links to the commit, the portfolio entry and the web page. Clicking a failed step reruns only that brick.

shapes.label: Sketched
shapes.desc: A blurred box for all the ideas that might not be prototype and ready to run
zooming in on the brick network window
zooming out
